+    response = requests.get(f"{base}/.well-known/openid-configuration", timeout=10)

+        "redirect_uri": config.redirect_uri,
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "scope": config.scope,
+        "state": state,
+        "nonce": nonce,
+    }

+        params["audience"] = config.audience

+
